ideas.pitch: An AI-powered platform using open-source satellite imagery and computer vision to track industrial expansion and illegal land encroachment on protected green belts around Pune.
ideas.title: EcoWatch Pune: Satellite Land Use and Encroachment Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors a proven winner by applying spatial AI to local environmental and industrial compliance, appealing heavily to judges looking for measurable SDG 15 (Life on Land) impact.

ideas.pitch: A machine learning pipeline that ingests local IoT sensor data and weather forecasts to predict heavy metal contamination spikes and dissolved oxygen drops in the Mula-Mutha river 48 hours in advance.
ideas.title: AquaPredict Pune: Mula-Mutha River Water Quality Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses local environmental realities in Pune with predictive analytics, following the winning blueprint of proactive ecological monitoring.

ideas.pitch: An edge-AI garbage classification tool paired with an Arduino/TinkerCAD simulation that identifies dry, wet, and hazardous waste in real time to optimize municipal recycling routes.
ideas.title: SmartBins Pune: IoT & AI Waste Segregation Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hardware and AI with immediate, practical application for urban municipal corporations managing urban waste under SDG 11.

ideas.pitch: A predictive mapping tool analyzing urban density, historical temperature anomalies, and dry vegetation indexes to highlight high-risk heat island and urban fire zones across Pune districts.
ideas.title: UrbanHeat AI: Pune Micro-Climate & Wildfire Risk Mapper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts proven climate-risk modeling techniques into an accessible dashboard format that municipal planners can immediately evaluate during a live demo.

ideas.pitch: A backend service and digital twin platform that monitors lithium-ion battery health metrics for localized community solar installations to prevent premature failure and optimize energy storage.
ideas.title: GridSmart Pune: Solar Micro-Grid Battery Health Digital Twin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages backend digital-twin architecture that previously won top honors in energy-focused hackathons, targeting SDG 7 (Affordable and Clean Energy).
